tables.name: entries
tables.label: Entries
tables.description: The universal node for this trip — the trip itself (kind=trip, one root row), a member (kind=member), or a piece of content (plan/event/todo/packing/note). One table so multiuser SHARING actually works: the share pipeline only syncs tables literally named `entries`/`relations`/`users` (custom table names are silently dropped on invite) — see MIGRATION.md.

tables.name: relations
tables.label: Relations
tables.description: The edges of the graph — mirrors Dispatch's shape exactly: each row links two entries {fromId, toId, type}. type `contains` is the structural trip-root -> item edge the share pipeline's subtree walk follows to pull in everything on the trip; there are no other edge types in v1.
